purpose: bounded prospective development coverage; no reuse of failed calibration as training

trials.activity: Home feed/photos: scroll for 60 seconds; leave Reels for its separate recording.
Reels: watch several different clips for 60 seconds.
On a later date, browse Explore/search and two or three public profiles for 60 seconds.
Choose a video from the home page and watch for 60 seconds.
Fresh selection visit: mix feed scrolling and Reels for 60 seconds.
Fresh selection visit: choose a different video and watch for 60 seconds.

eligibility_description: Retain every fixed-matcher reference in inventory. Export every mapped supported flow with >=5 actual packets, unique socket, no missing browser prefix and zero within-direction payload-size mismatch. Record every feature exclusion; never select by activity, model prediction or confidence. Other supported references remain saved and explicitly unscored by the two-target local study.
window_condition: Refresh the rebuilt Edge app; keep Edge and normal Chrome visible side by side. Default Strip private information NetLog, raw/sensitive bytes off, both logs before opening a fresh target connection.

families: existing compact TCN with CE only

limits: Six new deliberate captures maximum in this plan, not an open-ended request to repeat calibration. If support/quality gates fail, record the shortfall; no automatic extra capture, role rewrite, relaxed acceptance rule or guaranteed improvement. Timing/order parity and small-sample limits remain explicit.
